title: [bug] CI failure: mock_without_driver_test subprocess can't find bundled gems
description: test/mock_without_driver_test.rb:41 fails on all Ruby versions (3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 4.0). The test spawns a subprocess that loads bundler setup, but the subprocess can't find gems in Gemfile.lock (rubocop-1.86.0, sequel-5.102.0, json-2.19.3, etc.) because CI vendor/bundle doesn't include dev deps. Likely triggered by commit c656cc8 which updated Gemfile.lock via bundle update json.
close_reason: Used Bundler.with_unbundled_env to properly isolate subprocess from bundler env vars. The old approach set BUNDLE_GEMFILE to empty string which caused bundler to fall back to the main Gemfile.

title: HIGH: Ruby JSON format string injection vulnerability
description: Dependabot security alert: json >= 2.18.0, < 2.19.2 has a format string injection vulnerability. Fix: upgrade to 2.19.2.

title: Change database_type from :hexspace to :spark
description:
Hexspace::DatabaseMethods#database_type currently returns :hexspace, but it should return :spark since hexspace is just a transport (Thrift client for HiveServer2) — the actual RDBMS is Spark. All downstream code (RdbmsAdapter.generate, ConceptQL::Rdbms, make_readyable, setup_spark_if_needed!, ExportTest#db) checks for :spark. Returning :hexspace causes those checks to silently fail, likely breaking CI Spark export tests.

Change: In lib/sequel/adapters/shared/hexspace.rb, remove the database_type override so the inherited Spark::DatabaseMethods#database_type (:spark) takes effect. Update any tests that assert database_type == :hexspace.
close_reason: Changed database_type from :hexspace to :spark in commit 3e701d6. PG tests pass (1480/0 failures), DuckDB smoke test passes (10/0).

title: Fix Dependabot security alert: json format string injection
description: High severity: Ruby JSON has a format string injection vulnerability (alert #1, package: json)

title: Fix flaky schema_test.rb temp view cleanup
description: test/schema_test.rb:378 fails intermittently because sequel_test_view2 (created as a temp view in the 'Database#tables and #views' block around line 328) is not cleaned up before the 'Database' block runs its schema-filtered views test, which then expects only [:v1] but gets [:v1, :sequel_test_view2]. Add proper cleanup of temp views between describe blocks.
close_reason: Added drop_view(:sequel_test_view2) rescue nil to the after block of 'Database#tables and #views' describe block. The temp view created at line 329 was leaking into the 'Database' describe block, causing the schema-filtered views test to fail.

title: Add just test recipe matching CI test suite
description: Create or update a justfile with a test recipe that runs the complete test suite for this project, matching what .github/workflows/ runs on CI. The goal: running just test locally passes if and only if CI will pass when the current commit is pushed to GitHub. Examine the CI workflow YAML to determine the exact test command, any setup steps (DB, env vars), and language version expectations. Use bundle exec for Ruby, uv run for Python, Rscript for R. Exit non-zero on any test failure.
